speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma (likely stage IV with splenic involvement). The combination of B-symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss), massively enlarged and fixed lymph nodes (supraclavicular, mediastinal, axillary), elevated LDH, and splenomegaly in a smoker is highly characteristic. The lack of specific findings regarding alcohol-induced pain relief makes primary liver malignancy less likely as the sole diagnosis.
